question: How many subjects are there in the IAI course?
expected_answer: 9 modules including the Master's thesis; two of them are compulsory-elective containers holding several subjects each

question: How many credits is Data Science worth?
expected_answer: 5 ECTS

question: When do results get announced each semester?
expected_answer: Not covered by the regulations — refer to the Zentrales Prüfungsamt / HISinOne

question: I was sick and missed an exam — what do I do now?
expected_answer: Withdrawal by non-attendance requires no reasons (§ 11a Abs. 1) — you have validly withdrawn and may retake. If you began the exam and broke off, apply to the Prüfungsausschuss (§ 11a Abs. 3)

question: I failed Artificial Intelligence — can I get it re-evaluated or must I retake?
expected_answer: No re-evaluation procedure exists. You may inspect the paper (§ 30) and request review of a decision within one month (§ 18 Abs. 2). Failed Modulteilprüfungen may be retaken twice (§ 16 Abs. 1)

question: How long do I have to write my Master's thesis?
expected_answer: Six months (D3 Re § 21 Para. 5) — this overrides D1 § 21 Abs. 5 which states four to six months

question: How many times can I retake a failed exam?
expected_answer: Twice — three attempts in total. Failing the third means finally failed (§ 16 Abs. 1 Sätze 2 and 4)

question: Do I have to register for exams myself?
expected_answer: Compulsory modules are registered automatically by the Zentrales Prüfungsamt; compulsory-elective modules require your own application (§ 11 Abs. 1). D3 adds that registration is with the Examinations Office and is binding

question: How long is the standard period of study?
expected_answer: Three semesters (§ 2 Abs. 1)

question: What happens if I do not finish within the standard period?
expected_answer: You have three further semesters. After that the right to take examinations and the enrolment expire unless the delay was not your fault (§ 3 Abs. 6)

question: How many hours of work is one ECTS credit?
expected_answer: 30 hours (§ 4 Abs. 1 Satz 2)

question: What is the minimum passing grade?
expected_answer: 4.0 ('ausreichend'). Ungraded components pass with 'bestanden' (§ 15 Abs. 1)

question: Is there a grade of 4.3?
expected_answer: No. The permitted grades are 1.0, 1.3, 1.7, 2.0, 2.3, 2.7, 3.0, 3.3, 3.7, 4.0, 4.7, 5.0 — 4.3 is absent from the list (§ 14 Abs. 1 Satz 4)

question: Do I have to do an oral master's examination or defend my thesis?
expected_answer: No. D1 §§ 22 and 23 apply only if the Special Part provides for them; D3 Re § 3 Para. 1 states the Master's examination consists of module examinations and the thesis only

question: How long do I get to write the thesis if I need an extension?
expected_answer: Up to two further months, decided by the first examiner (D3 Re § 21 Para. 5)

question: What grade do I need to pass with distinction?
expected_answer: 1.3 or better gives 'mit Auszeichnung bestanden' (§ 25 Abs. 3)

question: How is the final overall grade calculated?
expected_answer: Weighted mean of module grades plus the thesis grade, weighted by ECTS; only the first decimal place counts and further digits are dropped without rounding (§ 25 Abs. 2)

question: Can I see my exam paper after it is marked?
expected_answer: Yes, on request, within one year of the end of the examination procedure (§ 30)

question: What happens if I am caught cheating?
expected_answer: The examination is graded 5.0 / 'not passed'. In serious cases the Prüfungsausschuss may exclude you from further examinations (§ 18 Abs. 1)

question: Can I study the IAI programme part-time?
expected_answer: Yes, in accordance with the current part-time study regulations (Studium iTz) (D3 Re § 3 Para. 7)

question: Are the lectures in English or German?
expected_answer: Regularly English. Compulsory-elective courses and their examinations may be held in German (D3 Re § 5)

question: Can I improve my grade with bonus points?
expected_answer: Yes — examiners may offer voluntary coursework for bonus points, capped at an improvement of 0.7 grade points, and only if the examination was already passed (D3 Re § 12 (8))

question: How much of my degree can be credited from work experience?
expected_answer: At most 50 percent of the degree from knowledge acquired outside the higher education system (§ 19 Abs. 4a)

question: What is a Portfolioprüfung?
expected_answer: An examination combining several different examination elements into one overall result (D2, annex to § 12)

question: What does Pf stand for in the study plan?
expected_answer: Portfolioprüfung. The link is not stated in any binding document — D1 § 31 and D3 Re § 31 define neither Pf nor CM nor CEM. It is inferable by matching D3's study plan against D4's examination forms

question: What is the module code for Data Science?
expected_answer: 2-020 per D3's study plan. D4's overview gives XX020, an unfilled placeholder, and repeats the same codes across both module groups

question: What do I need before I can start my Master's thesis?
expected_answer: D4 states at least 50 ECTS completed in the Master's programme in Industrial Engineering (WIW) — a different programme. No binding document states a 50-ECTS threshold for IAI. Refer to the Prüfungsausschuss

question: Which semester are the compulsory-elective modules in?
expected_answer: D3's study plan gives 1+2 for both 1-040 and 2-040; D4 states 2nd semester. D3 is binding and takes precedence

question: When did the IAI supplementary statute come into force?
expected_answer: The document contradicts itself: Article II says the day after publication, the announcement ran 03.03.2025 to 17.03.2025, but the stated date of entry into force is 01.03.2025 — before publication began

question: Does the general StuPO apply to Industrial Artificial Intelligence?
expected_answer: § 1 lists twelve Master's programmes and IAI is not among them, but D3 is drafted as a supplementary statute to it (§ 47) and amends its sections. Refer to the Prüfungsamt

question: What grade did I get in Data Science?
expected_answer: Personal examination data — not in the regulations. Check HISinOne

question: Am I registered for next semester's exams?
expected_answer: Personal registration status — not in the regulations. Check HISinOne or contact the Zentrales Prüfungsamt

question: When is my Operational Excellence lecture on Tuesday?
expected_answer: Timetable data — not in the regulations. Check WebUntis

question: Should I choose the Blockchain elective or Business Intelligence?
expected_answer: A matter of personal choice, not regulation. Speak to the Studiendekan or module coordinator

question: Will I pass if I study three hours a day?
expected_answer: Not something the regulations address

question: Is the IAI Master's degree recognised in India?
expected_answer: Not covered by these regulations. Contact the International Office or the relevant national recognition body

question: How many ECTS is the whole degree?
expected_answer: 90 ECTS including the thesis (D3 Re § 4 Para. 2)

question: How many ECTS is the Master's thesis worth?
expected_answer: 30 ECTS (D3 study plan). D1 § 21 Abs. 5 permits 15 to 30, so IAI sits at the top of the range

question: Who supervises the Master's thesis?
expected_answer: A professor issues and supervises it; an additional supervisor may be another full professor, a lecturer, or an experienced practitioner with at least equivalent qualification (§ 21 Abs. 2)

question: What happens if I fail the Master's thesis?
expected_answer: It may be repeated once; a second repeat is excluded. A new topic must be requested in writing within two months of being notified (§ 21 Abs. 8)

question: Can I take an online exam?
expected_answer: Yes — D2 inserted §§ 12a to 12e covering online examinations under video supervision, oral online examinations, open-book format and written online examinations

question: Is video supervision compulsory for online exams?
expected_answer: No. Online examinations under video supervision taken outside university rooms or test centres are voluntary, and an on-site alternative must normally be offered (D2 § 12b Abs. 2)

question: Which regulation version applies to me if the rules change?
expected_answer: The version in force when you began your studies (§ 44). Specific parts apply in the version current when the programme was started

question: How long after submitting do I wait for the thesis grade?
expected_answer: The assessment procedure should not exceed four weeks (§ 21 Abs. 7 Satz 5)

question: Can I get my certificate in English?
expected_answer: Yes, on request (§ 25 Abs. 6). The Diploma Supplement is issued in English as standard (§ 27)

question: What are the entry requirements from my bachelor's degree?
expected_answer: Not covered — admission requirements are in the separate Zulassungssatzung. Contact the Studentische Abteilung

question: Are there special rules for international students?
expected_answer: No. The four regulatory documents make no distinction by nationality. Visas, residence permits, insurance and tuition are outside their scope — contact the International Office

question: Are exams written or coursework?
expected_answer: Both. D2 replaced D1's list with eleven types: written exam, oral, electronic, presentation, practical work, lab work, term paper, practical report, Master's thesis, learning journal, portfolio. IAI's study plan uses R, Ha, La, Pf and X

question: What jobs will this master's degree prepare me for?
expected_answer: Not a matter for the regulations. D4's foreword discusses career fields but is descriptive, not binding — contact the Career Center

question: Is the Master's thesis a paper, a project or an internship?
expected_answer: An academic paper (D3 Re § 21 Para. 1). It may be done as group work if individual contributions are clearly separable (D1 § 21 Abs. 4) and may be carried out with a company with the Prüfungsausschuss chair's approval (D1 § 21 Abs. 2)
